SIRTAP tactical UAS completes first flight

Airbus Defence and Space and the Spanish Ministry of Defence confirmed that the SIRTAP tactical uncrewed aerial system completed its maiden flight at the Rota test range. The programme involves Indra and GMV and is intended to give the Spanish Army and Air Force a sovereign surveillance capability with an endurance of more than twenty hours. Detail paragraph 0 adds information about integration, payloads and next steps.
